Pinned source: upstream Moonlight Embedded 2.7.1 release asset (2025-11-30).
https://github.com/moonlight-stream/moonlight-embedded/releases/tag/v2.7.1
https://github.com/moonlight-stream/moonlight-embedded/wiki/Usage

Installed executable: /usr/bin/moonlight
This is the actual upstream streaming client. It uses the SDL frontend under
Weston, and software FFmpeg decoding in the initial Wayland implementation.
It does not provide Moonlight Qt's host-selection GUI. Surface HOME must provide
host/pairing controls and launch the commands below with explicit argv arrays.

Runtime environment:
  SDL_VIDEODRIVER=wayland
  SDL_RENDER_DRIVER=opengles2
  WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0
  XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/surface

Keep persistent pairing keys in /data/moonlight/keys, private mode0700.
Examples (HOST is an owner-supplied hostname/IP, never a hardcoded credential):
  moonlight pair -keydir /data/moonlight/keys HOST
  moonlight list -keydir /data/moonlight/keys HOST
  moonlight stream -platform sdl -codec h264 -720 -fps 60 -app Steam -keydir /data/moonlight/keys HOST

No Sunshine host is authorized/configured in this source tree. Pairing, remote
app listing, audiovisual streaming, latency, hardware decoding and Surface Go
performance require actual end-to-end tests. Do not mark these as verified from
a successful package build. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Q exits an active streaming session;
upstream also supports Play+Back+LeftShoulder+RightShoulder on a controller.
